justification: Both surfaces show schematic animals in profile alongside smaller repeated signs arranged in loose rows, but that is about as generic as figurative rock imagery gets. A is dominated by a single large frontal anthropomorph with a raised arm and outsized limbs surrounded by scattered small quadrupeds, whereas B is organised into stacked horizontal registers of crouching quadrupeds, a snake-like descending form and a large long-necked bird, with no human figure and a very different relief convention of modelled, rounded bodies versus flat silhouetted infill.
